blends.name: The WaxTales Fight Token
blends.desc:
The WaxTales Fight Token: Because Violence is Always the Answer (Sometimes)

Odds:
32% Empty
68% Wax, Packs or Characters

Ah, the Fight Token—a shiny little middle finger to common sense, granting its lucky (or soon-to-be-unlucky) holder the privilege of throwing hands with WaxTales, the enigmatic, wax-coated menace of the arena.

So, What’s the Deal?
You found it. Maybe in a back-alley dice game, maybe in the pocket of a guy who definitely didn’t need it anymore. But now it’s yours! Congratulations! You’ve just won a one-way ticket to Punch Town, population: you and a guy who may or may not be made entirely of candle wax.

The Rules (Because Apparently, We Need Those)
Fight. That’s it. That’s the rule. No weapons? Cool. Weapons? Even cooler. WaxTales doesn’t care. He’s been punched, stabbed, set on fire (ironic), and yet here he is, still standing.

Win (LOL). If—big if—you somehow knock WaxTales into next week, you get to dip your greedy little fingers into his treasure hoard.

Take Your “Prize.” Here’s the fun part: it might be real. It might be fake. It might just be a sad little illusion whispering, "You tried."

Why Would Anyone Do This?
Good question! Here are some excellent reasons:

You enjoy pain.

You think wax is weak to fire (it is, but WaxTales is not wax, surprise!).

You’re bored, and gambling with your life sounds like a you problem.

You really, really want that "treasure," even if it turns out to be a rock painted gold.

Possible Outcomes (Spoiler: Most of Them Are Bad)
✅ You win! Take your prize! (50% chance it’s a heartfelt note that says, "Better luck next time, dumbass.")
❌ You lose. WaxTales adds your teeth to his collection.
🤡 You technically win, but the "treasure" is just a mirage. Enjoy your moral victory (and your broken ribs).

Final Warning (From Someone Who Definitely Cares)
This token is not an investment. It’s a dare. A joke. A bad decision waiting to happen. But hey, if you’re feeling lucky (or stupid), step right up. WaxTales is waiting.

And remember—if you die, it’s your fault.

"Come for the fight, stay because you're unconscious." —WaxTales, probably.
